==Notes==
* This skill may seem to last indefinitely, but actually has a [[duration]] of 7 hours and 30 minutes, making it the longest finite duration for an effect in the game.
** This skill can be activated well before triggering its effect, allowing for it to recharge before battle.
** Since this is a shout, this can be used to trigger [[Soldier's Speed]]'s additional effect for [[run]]ning purposes, or [[Signet of Aggression]] for building adrenaline before the fight. 
*[[Miss]]ed or [[block]]ed attacks don't count toward the number of attacks.
*"Attacks" by this skill are considered to be hits, thus if you hit three enemies with a [[scythe]], that counts as three attacks toward this shout.
{{anomaly|Unlike most shouts, "I Am the Strongest!" ends if it's reapplied before it expires, triggering the effects of [[echo (skill type)|echo]]es.}}

==Trivia==
*The [[Norn]] in the [[skill icon]] is [[Jora]], wearing her [[Brotherhood armor]].
*The skill name is a reference to a winning quote of the character [[w:Chun-Li|Chun-Li]] from the [[w:Street Fighter|Street Fighter games]] ([http://wiki.guildwars.com/index.php?title=Talk:%22I_Am_the_Strongest!%22&diff=1217955#Trivia source]).
